summary: PR-123 can have a non-self-referential C2 mechanics oracle if the reviewed spec fixes the analytic fields, exact modified-wavenumber references, boundary and interpolation decompositions, stochastic domain of the sqrt(2) lock, and a property-based kill contract for all nine historical mutations before implementation. This result used no observed catalogue, no PR4 command, and no sibling result.

not_claimed: corrected observed CF4 or any other catalogue result
matched-null, covariance, PPC, LOOCV, posterior, or evidence adequacy
Bianchi morphology, geometry, or family identification
native low-ell solver or native transfer validation
governing_scope.scientific_status_effect: none; all 102 remediation findings, including C6-K6-CURL-F1 through F4, remain OPEN until their later authorized closeout/adjudication

assumptions_and_conventions: The numerical K6 oracle lives on a right-handed Euclidean Cartesian grid (x,y,z); this is an observer-side vector-calculus mechanics check, not a spacetime or Bianchi metric calculation.
Velocity components are ordered (v_x,v_y,v_z), curl is right-handed, and solid-body v=Omega cross (x-x0) has curl(v)=2 Omega and div(v)=0.
Coordinates have length units L, velocity has V, and curl/divergence have V/L. Dimensionless ratios may be formed only with a nonzero, separately checked denominator.

Periodic analytic fixtures use a cube of side 2*pi with endpoint excluded. Nonperiodic manufactured-boundary fixtures declare their one-sided closure and are scored separately on interior and boundary faces.

The sqrt(2) lock assumes three independent, identically distributed stationary Gaussian vector components with isotropic derivative covariance. It does not apply unchanged to componentwise spatial amplitudes, anisotropic kernels, finite-boundary contamination, correlated components, or empirical fields.
Second- and fourth-order references mean their declared derivative stencils and boundary closures, not labels supplied by the caller. Observed convergence is an acceptance criterion.

Expected values are closed-form or independently sampled from the fixture definition; no expected value may call the production derivative, generator, scorer, posterior, or transfer evaluator under test.

required_properties: component/sign recovery for a non-axis-aligned Omega
translation invariance under x0 and arbitrary bulk b
proper-rotation covariance and explicit handedness failure under an axis/sign mutation
solid_body.purpose: catches sign, component, axis, and normalization defects; because linear fields are exact for both stencils, it is not a convergence oracle by itself

analytic_potential_plane_wave.field: theta=k dot x, k=(1,2,3), v=A k cos(theta), with integer periodic modes

independent_discrete_reference.fourth_order_modified_wavenumber: ktilde_j=(8 sin(k_j h)-sin(2 k_j h))/(6 h)

analytic_potential_plane_wave.purpose: the closed-form modified-wavenumber oracle is algorithmically smaller and does not call the array stencil; unequal k components make potential-flow truncation nonzero and prevent a tautological discrete-gradient/curl cancellation

mixed_helmholtz.field: v=A k cos(k dot x)+B a cos(q dot x), q=(2,-1,1), a=(1,1,-1), q dot a=0, and q is not parallel to k
mixed_helmholtz.exact_reference: div(v)=-A |k|^2 sin(k dot x); curl(v)=B (a cross q) sin(q dot x)
required_properties: potential and solenoidal components are both nonzero
linearity under independently varied A and B
divergence does not acquire the solenoidal mode
curl does not acquire the continuum potential mode
mode-wise discrete errors match the corresponding modified-wavenumber formulas

required_scoring: interior L2 and Linfinity errors after excluding the declared stencil radius
boundary-face L2 and Linfinity errors for the declared one-sided closure
whole-volume error reported separately, never used to hide a first-order boundary
a default first-order one-sided boundary mutation must fail even if the interior slope passes

amplitude_kernel_boundary_decomposition.continuum_curl_identity: C_a=sum_{b,c} epsilon_{abc}[A_c partial_b eta_c+(partial_b A_c) eta_c]=C_kernel,a+C_amplitude,a
requirements: constant A eliminates the amplitude-gradient term exactly
variable analytic A compares each component term against closed-form derivatives
the scalar shorthand grad(A) cross eta is allowed only when all A_c are the same scalar field
boundary contribution is the difference between the same field/kernel under the declared finite extension and a padded or periodic reference, and must be reported by distance-to-boundary
kernel, amplitude-gradient, boundary, interpolation, and residual closure terms must sum to the direct numerical curl within a predeclared roundoff/truncation tolerance
amplitude_kernel_boundary_decomposition.current_risk: htt/obsstat/velocity_field_curl.py multiplies each smoothed component by spatially varying v_std, so calling the result stationary is false and the amplitude-gradient term is generally nonzero

interpolation_decomposition.fixture: shifted periodic plane waves evaluated analytically on both source and target grids
requirements: value interpolation order is checked before differentiation
curl/divergence interpolation error is separated from derivative truncation
target points that require an undeclared boundary extrapolation are rejected, not silently filled
the decomposition identity closes numerically for every grid

sqrt2_residual_lock.assumption: Cov(partial_a eta_i, partial_b eta_j)=tau^2 delta_ab delta_ij for a zero-mean isotropic stationary three-component field
derivation: E|curl eta|^2=6 tau^2 because each of three curl components is a difference of two independent derivative components
E(div eta)^2=3 tau^2 because divergence is the sum of three independent diagonal derivative components
sqrt2_residual_lock.finite_sample_test: For N independent manufactured derivative tensors, C/(2D) follows F(3N,N), where C is pooled curl energy and D pooled divergence energy. Use a preregistered exact F interval or an independently fixed Monte Carlo interval; do not learn tolerance from the result.
metamorphic_properties: common amplitude cancels from the ratio
for a normalized Gaussian covariance with length R, both RMS derivatives scale as 1/R while the ratio stays sqrt(2)
anisotropic component variance, cross-component correlation, spatial amplitude gradients, or boundary contamination must break or explicitly suspend the lock
the lock is prior/synthetic residual mechanics and cannot support an empirical-field claim

upper_bound_and_continuum.central_difference_bound: For stencil order p, |(curl_h-curl)_x| <= C_p h^p (||partial_y^(p+1) v_z||_inf+||partial_z^(p+1) v_y||_inf), cyclically, with C_2=1/6 and C_4=1/30 for the standard centered first derivatives away from boundaries.
requirements: use at least four preregistered grids and both p=2 and p=4 stencils
report local pairwise orders and a log(error)-log(h) fit; do not accept one favorable pair
require monotone asymptotic error decrease before floating-point saturation
Richardson/continuum extrapolation for the analytic potential fixture must be compatible with zero
a numerical potential-flow curl is an upper bound on unresolved curl plus discretization only; it is not measured physical vorticity

array curl/div errors agree with the closed-form modified-wavenumber values; fitted orders are in [1.8,2.2] and [3.6,4.4] respectively, with no survivor of a downgraded fourth-order mutation
analytic curl and divergence modes recover separately, amplitude superposition holds, and each order meets the same convergence bands
interior and boundary-face convergence both meet their declared order; a first-order one-sided closure is killed on the boundary-face norm

recommended_k6_acceptance_matrix.pass: value interpolation and downstream curl/div errors meet their declared orders and E_total=E_interp+E_stencil closes

recommended_k6_acceptance_matrix.pass: kernel, amplitude-gradient, boundary, interpolation, and residual terms close independently; common-scalar and componentwise formulas are not conflated

numerical_dry_run.purpose: sanity-check that the proposed nontrivial fixtures expose the advertised orders before they are frozen in the spec
numerical_dry_run.interpretation: The proposed plane-wave and boundary fixtures are nondegenerate: clean p=2/p=4 paths separate, while a first-order boundary mutation remains visible instead of being diluted by the interior. These numbers are fixture-design evidence, not acceptance outputs or scientific results.
numerical_dry_run.reproduction_definition: Periodic D2 uses (f[i+1]-f[i-1])/(2h); D4 uses (-f[i+2]+8f[i+1]-8f[i-1]+f[i-2])/(12h). The nonperiodic closure differentiates the degree-2 or degree-4 local interpolation polynomial. Fields and grids are exactly those specified in physics_math_audit.

oracle_lineage_requirements: Each lane records reference algorithm, source/equation, fixture generator, author/reviewer identities, random-stream IDs, shared equations, and known shared assumptions.

File-path separation is not independence. The closed-form K6 modified-wavenumber calculation must not import the array derivative implementation; the real-white-noise GRF reference must not call the half-spectrum generator; conjugate statistical references must not call production evidence/PPC code.
Every mutation ID and acceptance threshold is frozen before mutation execution. A surviving mutation remains in the report and blocks only its lane; it is not deleted or replaced post hoc.
Reference code must remain smaller than production and expose assumptions. If it becomes a second production stack, the lane is inconclusive pending a new independent oracle.
Multi-seed tests bind the full seed list or seed-sequence root before execution and report per-seed failures, aggregate interval construction, and any multiplicity policy.
kill_switches: Any preregistered mutation survives, is skipped, or is executed against a different property than registered: block that lane.
Any expected result is generated by the production function under test or independence lineage is incomplete: block oracle-independence for that lane.
Any K6 artifact reads a CF4/catalogue/raw-data path, has empirical_consumer_count nonzero, or is consumed by an empirical field claim: invalidate the K6 PR-123 card.
Either stencil misses convergence, the boundary closure is undeclared, or interpolation/boundary/amplitude terms do not close: block the affected K6 mechanics lane.
The sqrt(2) lock is asserted for a spatially varying componentwise amplitude, anisotropic/correlated field, or contaminated boundary without a new derivation: block the lock claim.
An external/release transfer range is stale or the requested domain is outside it: block evaluation; never extrapolate and never promote it to native.
A mechanics pass is used to mark any remediation finding RESCUED or to promote matched data/null/covariance/scientific status: fail the claim firewall.

findings.statement: The K6 lane needs exact solid-body, non-tautological potential, mixed Helmholtz, manufactured-boundary, multi-grid/multi-stencil, continuum, and numerical-upper-bound clauses. A same-stencil discrete-gradient self-oracle is insufficient.
findings.required_action: Freeze the fields, grids, stencils, boundary closures, exact modified-wavenumber formulas, convergence bands, and lane-local kill behavior in pr123_spec.yaml before implementation.

findings.statement: The sqrt(2) residual ratio is an analytic covariance lock only for iid-component isotropic stationary derivatives. Componentwise spatial v_std scaling creates amplitude-gradient terms and invalidates an unconditional lock.
findings.required_action: Implement the analytic constant-amplitude lock, the componentwise product-rule decomposition, and challenge fixtures that suspend the lock under anisotropy, amplitude gradients, or boundary contamination.

findings.statement: Each historical mutation needs a mechanism-sensitive metamorphic or closed-form property, not a schema flag or stored expected number. The nine required property families are enumerated in statistical_mutation_properties.
findings.required_action: Register the exact mutation IDs, clean fixtures, independent reference lineages, seed roots, and kill properties before executing the matrix; retain every survivor as a lane blocker.

findings.statement: PR-123 can validate only lane-specific synthetic/analytic mechanics. It must have zero empirical consumers and must not close any remediation finding or promote matched-null/covariance/scientific status.
findings.required_action: Require explicit empirical_inputs=[], empirical_consumer_count=0, transfer_source=none_or_synthetic, and C2 mechanics-only caveats in the K6 card and result graph.

claim_results.reason: The assignment derived a coherent, falsifiable oracle and mutation contract. Implementation acceptance remains pending the reviewed spec, clean mutation execution, independent-lineage evidence, and all registered gates.
